input.question: Why public pools take 'safety breaks' for a few minutes?
input.ground_truth: * to give swimmer who might be fatigued, dehydrated, or cold a change to come out of the water * to give the lifeguards a break * to clear to pool in case any cleaning or maintenance is necessary * to keep people used to listening to the life guards * as a segue to adult swim * to give parents an convenient time to get their kids out of the pool and leave
